questions.question: To compare the snapshot against the board, /phil:resume must read Projects v2 Status + board position. No gh verb that can do that reliably is read-only. Which cost do we pay?

options.label: Flip resume to mutates: true (Recommended)
options.description: Grant Bash(gh api graphql:*) and declare mutates: true, carrying the read-only intent in prose — the adversarial-review pattern CLAUDE.md already blesses. The check is faithful: it sees Status, board position, and the top Todo card. Cost: resume.md's line 'the read-only guarantee is enforced rather than merely declared' stops being true. Mitigating: the grant stays narrow — still no Write, no Edit, no bare Bash — so the mutation surface is one verb bounded by prose, tighter than adversarial-review's bare Bash.
options.preview:
---
mutates: true
allowed-tools: Read, Glob, Grep,
  Bash(git rev-parse:*), Bash(git status:*),
  Bash(git rev-list:*), Bash(git log:*),
  Bash(gh api graphql:*), Skill
---

This command never writes. Its only non-git
verb is `gh api graphql`, used for BOARD READS
only — it declares `true` because that verb
can carry a mutation, not because it does.

options.label: Keep mutates: false, use gh issue list
options.description: gh issue list is already on the read-only allowlist. But it returns issues + milestones, not Status and not board position — so resume cannot see 'the top Todo card' or any In Progress card at all. The check degrades to 'is the snapshot's Next inside the earliest-due milestone's open set', which would likely have MISSED the 2026-08-13 case the card was written from. Enforcement preserved; the detector is weaker than its own done-when.
options.preview:
allowed-tools: ..., Bash(gh issue list:*)

Visible:   number, title, labels, milestone
Invisible: Status field  ← the board column
           board position ← 'top Todo'
           In Progress    ← 'what is in flight'

The 2026-08-13 divergence would likely
read as agreement.

options.label: Keep mutates: false, allowlist gh project item-list
options.description: gh project item-list is genuinely read-only, so enforcement survives and the check sees Status. But CLAUDE.md forbids it for board reads: it served a stale title for #10 on 2026-08-12 and can under-report. An under-report here means a divergence that exists and is not reported — the exact silent failure this card was written to kill, reintroduced inside its own fix.
options.preview:
READ_ONLY_VERBS += "gh project item-list"

CLAUDE.md, Issue board:
  "Read the board with `gh api graphql`,
   NEVER `gh project item-list` — item-list
   served a stale title for #10 and can
   under-report."

Under-report → missed divergence → silent.
